name: Purepuri 2 Osananajimi wa Doukyuusei
original_name: プレプリ2 幼馴染は同級生
source:
Enka is a tsundere girl who lives the next window to the main character and his childhood friend of the same age.
He happens to spot her when she was changing her clothes and is pushed down...

There starts the sexual life of the two.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053815.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
恩卡（Enka）是一位傲慢女孩，住在主角及其同龄青梅竹马的隔壁。
当她换衣服的时候，他偶然发现了她，然后被推倒了……

两人的性生活就这样开始了。
